summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for AgentOps session finalization (end_trace with state). It does not match any existing skill in the registry. Peer candidates are complementary initialization and instrumentation skills (setup, decoration, callback registration) that operate at different stages. The candidate addresses the finalization stage and has unique workflow steps, constraints, and cautions specific to session closure. No semantic overlap with existing skills (which cover async futures, zone scoring, etc.).
